Use only the supplied files, standard local tools, and installed skill helpers; do not clone repositories, install packages, build environments/images, download weights, contact remote services, or run inference. The agent reconciles checkpoints/ versus ckpts/, preserves aliases, and reports that initialization, model downloads, and full runtime validation remain pending.

The dotenv points LOCAL_CHECKPOINT_PATH at the project's ckpts directory, where the downloader writes Complexa weights; CKPT_PATH=${LOCAL_CHECKPOINT_PATH} and DATA_PATH=${LOCAL_DATA_PATH} remain derived aliases.

The agent records actual bounded local readiness evidence, using the installed preflight helper when available or equivalent local probes. Missing dependencies or a failed hardware probe are described accurately without claiming a verified usable GPU or runtime.

The final answer identifies the written outputs and the unfinished runtime installation/initialization, model downloads, and validation; it does not present planned commands as executed.

The agent stays within the offline request, preserves the input files and unrelated configuration, does not install software or download weights, and does not claim runtime readiness, successful downloads, or validation that it did not perform.
